facts.text: Domestic high school seniors with an unweighted GPA of 2.75 or higher qualify for direct admission to Northern Kentucky University for full-time post-graduation attendance.

sources.title: NKU Direct Admissions
sources.quote: As a high school senior with an unweighted GPA of 2.75 or higher, you qualify for direct admission. Reminder: Direct Admission is available to domestic high school seniors who will be attending college full-time for the first time after graduation.

facts.text: Northern Kentucky University requires all new first-year students to live on campus unless they qualify for an approved exemption.

sources.title: Student Engagement - Northern Kentucky University
sources.quote: Unless qualifying for an exemption, new first-year students are required to live on campus.
